purpose: Teach: 鉄鋼/請負/車体/減量/オペレーション/戸籍/養子/打開

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、鉄鋼業界の動向を把握しろ
lines.en: Stay on top of where the steel industry is headed.
lines.style: Crisp, commanding. Clean attack on the opening. Measured pace. Authority without harshness. The tone of someone used to being heard.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新規請負契約を進めております
lines.en: Yes, sir. We're moving forward with the new contract acquisitions.
lines.style: Respectful, precise. Steady pace. The measured confidence of someone reporting progress. Direct eye contact in the voice—no hesitation.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、車体製造ラインを見直せ
lines.en: Review our vehicle assembly line operations.
lines.style: Focused, decisive. Sharp onset. Slightly faster pace than the previous directive. The tone of someone checking boxes on a larger strategy.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。在庫減量の方針で進めております
lines.en: Understood. We're already moving ahead with inventory reduction across the board.
lines.style: Composed, professional. Calm opening. Slightly quicker pace to show readiness. The assurance of someone who anticipated the question.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、海外オペレーションを強化しろ
lines.style: Clipped, non-negotiable. No softness in the delivery. Steady tempo. The final item in a series—less elaborate, more certain.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員の戸籍関連手続きをサポートしております
lines.en: Yes, sir. We're providing support with staff documentation and administrative procedures overseas.
lines.style: Efficient, thorough. Slight quickening to match the expanded scope. Factual tone—laying out the groundwork already in place.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 社員家族の養子縁組のお手伝いも検討しろ
lines.en: Also look into supporting our employees with family registration matters, including adoption procedures if needed.
lines.style: Steady, thoughtful. Slower onset—this is a more delicate directive. Measured pace. The care of someone thinking beyond immediate business.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。現状打開のため新プロジェクトを企画しております
lines.en: Yes, sir. We're designing a new initiative to address the current challenges head-on.
lines.style: Engaged, forward-looking. Slight rise in energy. Confident closing pace. The tone of someone showing how everything connects to the larger vision.
